86template <bool Enabled, class Storage, template <class> class CritSec>
87struct value_bitmask_field {
88 CritSec<Storage> bits{};
89
90 [[nodiscard]] bool test(std::uint8_t i) const noexcept {
91 const auto bval = bits.load();
92 if (UNODB_DETAIL_UNLIKELY(i >= sizeof(Storage) * 8)) return false;
93 return (bval >> i) & 1U;
94 }
95 void set(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
96 bits = static_cast<Storage>(bits.load() | (Storage{1} << i));
97 }
98 void clear(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
99 bits = static_cast<Storage>(bits.load() & ~(Storage{1} << i));
100 }
102 void remove_at(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
103 const Storage bval = bits.load();
104 const auto above =
105 static_cast<Storage>(bval >> static_cast<unsigned>(i + 1));
106 const auto below = static_cast<Storage>(bval & ((Storage{1} << i) - 1));
107 bits = static_cast<Storage>(below | (above << i));
108 }
111 void insert_at(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
112 const Storage bval = bits.load();
113 const auto above = static_cast<Storage>(bval >> i);
114 const auto below = static_cast<Storage>(bval & ((Storage{1} << i) - 1));
115 bits =
116 static_cast<Storage>(below | (above << static_cast<unsigned>(i + 1)));
117 }
118};
119
121template <bool Enabled, class T, std::size_t N, template <class> class CritSec>
122struct value_bitmask_field<Enabled, std::array<T, N>, CritSec> {
123 std::array<CritSec<T>, N> bits{};
124
125 [[nodiscard]] bool test(std::uint8_t i) const noexcept {
126 const T byte_val = bits[static_cast<std::size_t>(i) / 8].load();
127 return (static_cast<unsigned>(byte_val) >>
128 (static_cast<unsigned>(i) % 8U)) &
129 1U;
130 }
131 void set(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
132 const auto idx = static_cast<std::size_t>(i) / 8;
133 bits[idx] = static_cast<T>(bits[idx].load() |
134 (T{1} << (static_cast<unsigned>(i) % 8U)));
135 }
136 void clear(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
137 const auto idx = static_cast<std::size_t>(i) / 8;
138 bits[idx] = static_cast<T>(bits[idx].load() &
139 ~(T{1} << (static_cast<unsigned>(i) % 8U)));
140 }
141};

149 static constexpr void set(std::uint8_t) noexcept {}

186template <class ArtPolicy>
187struct bulk_subtree_guard {
188 using db_type = typename ArtPolicy::db_type;
189 using node_ptr = typename ArtPolicy::node_ptr;
190
191 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_;
192 node_ptr ptr{nullptr};
193 bool is_packed_value{false};
194
195 constexpr explicit bulk_subtree_guard(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db
196 UNODB_DETAIL_LIFETIMEBOUND) noexcept
197 : db_{db} {}
198
199 ~bulk_subtree_guard() noexcept {
200 if (ptr != nullptr && !is_packed_value) {
201 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(ptr, db_);
202 }
203 }
204
205 void release() noexcept { ptr = nullptr; }
206
207 bulk_subtree_guard(const bulk_subtree_guard&) = delete;
208 // LCOV_EXCL_START — move ctor only called on vector reallocation
209 bulk_subtree_guard(bulk_subtree_guard&& other) noexcept
210 : db_{other.db_},
211 ptr{std::exchange(other.ptr, nullptr)},
212 is_packed_value{other.is_packed_value} {}
213 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
214 auto& operator=(const bulk_subtree_guard&) = delete;
215 auto& operator=(bulk_subtree_guard&&) = delete;
216};

282//
283// TODO(thompsonbry) Partial or no key in leaf. Once we template for the Value
284// type, we can optimize for u64 or smaller values, the leaf should be replaced
285// by the use of a variant {Value,node_ptr} entry in the inode along with a bit
286// mask to indicate for each position whether it is a leaf or a node. This
287// provides a significant optimization for secondary index use cases (tree
288// height is reduced by one, no small allocations for leaves, the key is no
289// longer explicitly stored, the key size is no longer stored, the value size is
290// no longer stored, etc.). However, we would still need to allocate a leaf for
291// the case where Value is a std::span. But this becomes a simple immutable
292// data structure which exists solely to wrap the Value.
293template <class Key, class Header>
294class [[nodiscard]] basic_leaf final : public Header {
295 public:
298 using key_size_type = unodb::key_size_type;
299
302 using value_size_type = unodb::value_size_type;
303
305 static constexpr std::size_t max_key_size =
306 std::numeric_limits<key_size_type>::max();
307
309 static constexpr std::size_t max_value_size =
310 std::numeric_limits<value_size_type>::max();
311
313 using art_key_type = basic_art_key<Key>;
314
315 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26485)
316
317 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26481)
322 constexpr basic_leaf(art_key_type k, value_view v) noexcept
323 : key_size{static_cast<key_size_type>(k.size())},
324 value_size{static_cast<value_size_type>(v.size())} {
325 // Note: Runtime checks are handled upstream of this by
326 // make_db_leaf_ptr().
327 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(k.size() <= max_key_size);
328 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(v.size() <= max_value_size);
329
330 const auto tmp{k.get_key_view()};
331 std::memcpy(data, tmp.data(), key_size); // store encoded key
332 if (!v.empty()) std::memcpy(data + key_size, v.data(), value_size);
333 }

599template <typename Key, typename Value,
600 template <typename, typename, typename> class Db,
601 typename HeapTag = void>
602[[nodiscard]] auto make_db_leaf_ptr(
603 basic_art_key<Key> k, Value v,
604 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST Db<Key, Value, HeapTag>& db
605 UNODB_DETAIL_LIFETIMEBOUND) {
606 using db_type = Db<Key, Value, HeapTag>;
607 using header_type = typename db_type::header_type;
608 using leaf_type = basic_leaf<leaf_key_type<Key, Value>, header_type>;
609
610 if constexpr (!can_eliminate_key_in_leaf_v<Key, Value> &&
611 std::is_same_v<Key, key_view>) {
612 if (UNODB_DETAIL_UNLIKELY(k.size() > leaf_type::max_key_size)) {
613 throw std::length_error("Key length must fit in std::uint32_t");
614 }
615 }
616
617 // Serialize value to bytes for leaf storage.
618 value_view leaf_val_bytes;
619 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26496)
620 [[maybe_unused]] std::byte val_buf[sizeof(Value)]{};
621 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
622 if constexpr (std::is_same_v<Value, value_view>) {
623 leaf_val_bytes = v;
624 } else {
625 static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<Value>);
626 std::memcpy(val_buf, &v, sizeof(v));
627 leaf_val_bytes = value_view{val_buf, sizeof(v)};
628 }
629
630 if (UNODB_DETAIL_UNLIKELY(leaf_val_bytes.size_bytes() >
631 leaf_type::max_value_size)) {
632 throw std::length_error("Value length must fit in std::uint32_t");
633 }
634
635 std::size_t size;
636 if constexpr (can_eliminate_key_in_leaf_v<Key, Value>) {
637 size = leaf_type::compute_size(
638 static_cast<typename leaf_type::value_size_type>(
639 leaf_val_bytes.size_bytes()));
640 } else {
641 size = leaf_type::compute_size(
642 static_cast<typename leaf_type::key_size_type>(k.size()),
643 static_cast<typename leaf_type::value_size_type>(
644 leaf_val_bytes.size_bytes()));
645 }
646
647 auto* const leaf_mem = static_cast<std::byte*>(db.get_allocator().alloc(
648 size, alignment_for_new<leaf_type>(), db.get_allocator().ctx));
649
650#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_WITH_STATS
651 db.increment_leaf_count(size);
652#endif // UNODB_DETAIL_WITH_STATS
653
654 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26402)
655 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26400)
656 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26496)
657 auto* const leaf = [&]() noexcept {
658 if constexpr (can_eliminate_key_in_leaf_v<Key, Value>) {
659 return new (leaf_mem) leaf_type{leaf_val_bytes};
660 } else {
661 return new (leaf_mem) leaf_type{k, leaf_val_bytes};
662 }
663 }();
664 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
665 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
666 return basic_db_leaf_unique_ptr<Key, Value, header_type, Db>{
667 leaf, basic_db_leaf_deleter<db_type>{db}};
668 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
669}

710 const auto leaf_size = to_delete->get_size();
711 const auto& alloc = db.get_allocator();
712 alloc.dealloc(to_delete, leaf_size, alloc.ctx);

720inline void basic_db_inode_deleter<INode, Db>::operator()(
721 INode* inode_ptr) noexcept {
722 static_assert(std::is_trivially_destructible_v<INode>);
723
724 const auto& alloc = db.get_allocator();
725 alloc.dealloc(inode_ptr, sizeof(INode), alloc.ctx);
726
727#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_WITH_STATS
728 db.template decrement_inode_count<INode>();
729#endif // UNODB_DETAIL_WITH_STATS

748template <typename Key, typename Value,
749 template <typename, typename, typename> class Db,
750 template <class> class CriticalSectionPolicy, class LockPolicy,
751 class ReadCriticalSection, class NodePtr,
752 template <typename, typename, typename> class INodeDefs,
753 template <typename, typename, class, typename> class INodeReclamator,
754 template <class> class LeafReclamator, typename HeapTag = void>
755struct basic_art_policy final {
758
760 using key_type = Key;
761
763 using value_type = Value;
764
766 using art_key_type = basic_art_key<Key>;
767
769 using node_ptr = NodePtr;
770
772 using header_type = typename NodePtr::header_type;
773
775 using lock_policy = LockPolicy;
776
778 using read_critical_section = ReadCriticalSection;
779
781 using inode_defs = INodeDefs<Key, Value, HeapTag>;
782
784 using inode = typename inode_defs::inode;
785
787 using inode4_type = typename inode_defs::n4;
788
790 using inode16_type = typename inode_defs::n16;
791
793 using inode48_type = typename inode_defs::n48;
794
796 using inode256_type = typename inode_defs::n256;
797
799 using tree_depth_type = tree_depth<art_key_type>;
800
803 static constexpr bool value_in_slot =
804 !std::is_void_v<HeapTag> ? leaf_policy_for<HeapTag, Value>::value_in_slot
805 : (std::is_trivially_copyable_v<Value> &&
806 (sizeof(Value) <= sizeof(std::uint64_t)));
807 static_assert(sizeof(std::uintptr_t) <= sizeof(std::uint64_t),
808 "node_ptr must fit in a uint64_t slot");
809
813 static constexpr bool full_key_in_inode_path =
814 !std::is_void_v<HeapTag>
815 ? leaf_policy_for<HeapTag, Value>::full_key_in_inode_path
816 : std::is_same_v<Key, key_view>;
817
820 static constexpr bool can_eliminate_key_in_leaf =
821 !std::is_void_v<HeapTag>
822 ? leaf_policy_for<HeapTag, Value>::full_key_in_inode_path ||
823 leaf_policy_for<HeapTag, Value>::can_eliminate_leaf
824 : can_eliminate_key_in_leaf_v<Key, Value>;
825
830 static constexpr bool can_eliminate_leaf =

1071 struct delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit final {
1073 constexpr explicit delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit(
1074 NodePtr node_ptr_ UNODB_DETAIL_LIFETIMEBOUND,
1075 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_
1076 UNODB_DETAIL_LIFETIMEBOUND) noexcept
1077 : node_ptr{node_ptr_}, db{db_} {}
1078
1080 // MSVC C26815 false positive: the destructor creates unique_ptrs whose
1081 // deleters hold references to db. These are immediately destroyed while db
1082 // (a member reference) is still valid - the constructor's LIFETIMEBOUND
1083 // guarantees the referent outlives this object.
1084 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26815)
1085 ~delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit() noexcept {
1086 switch (node_ptr.type()) {
1087 case node_type::LEAF: {
1088 if constexpr (!can_eliminate_leaf) {
1089 const auto r{
1090 make_db_leaf_ptr(node_ptr.template ptr<leaf_type*>(), db)};
1091 }
1092 return;
1093 }
1094 case node_type::I4: {
1095 // cppcheck-suppress throwInNoexceptFunction
1096 const auto r{make_db_inode_unique_ptr(
1097 node_ptr.template ptr<inode4_type*>(), db)};
1098 return;
1099 }
1100 case node_type::I16: {
1101 const auto r{make_db_inode_unique_ptr(
1102 node_ptr.template ptr<inode16_type*>(), db)};
1103 return;
1104 }
1105 case node_type::I48: {
1106 const auto r{make_db_inode_unique_ptr(
1107 node_ptr.template ptr<inode48_type*>(), db)};
1108 return;
1109 }
1110 case node_type::I256: {
1111 const auto r{make_db_inode_unique_ptr(
1112 node_ptr.template ptr<inode256_type*>(), db)};
1113 return;
1114 }
1115 }
1116 UNODB_DETAIL_CANNOT_HAPPEN(); // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
1117 }
1118 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
1119

1121 delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit(const delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit&) =
1122 delete;
1123
1125 delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit(delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit&&) =
1126 delete;
1127
1129 auto& operator=(const delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit&) = delete;
1130
1132 auto& operator=(delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit&&) = delete;
1133
1134 private:
1136 const NodePtr node_ptr;
1137
1139 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db;
1140 };

1151 UNODB_DETAIL_LIFETIMEBOUND) noexcept

1161 subtree_guard(subtree_guard&&) = delete;
1162 auto& operator=(const subtree_guard&) = delete;

1177 static void delete_subtree(
1178 NodePtr node, UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance) noexcept {
1179 delete_db_node_ptr_at_scope_exit delete_on_scope_exit{node, db_instance};
1180
1181 switch (node.type()) {
1182 case node_type::LEAF:
1183 return;
1184 case node_type::I4: {
1185 auto* const subtree_ptr{node.template ptr<inode4_type*>()};
1186 subtree_ptr->delete_subtree(db_instance);
1187 return;
1188 }
1189 case node_type::I16: {
1190 auto* const subtree_ptr{node.template ptr<inode16_type*>()};
1191 subtree_ptr->delete_subtree(db_instance);
1192 return;
1193 }
1194 case node_type::I48: {
1195 auto* const subtree_ptr{node.template ptr<inode48_type*>()};
1196 subtree_ptr->delete_subtree(db_instance);
1197 return;
1198 }
1199 case node_type::I256: {
1200 auto* const subtree_ptr{node.template ptr<inode256_type*>()};
1201 subtree_ptr->delete_subtree(db_instance);
1202 return;
1203 }
1204 }
1205 }

1212 [[gnu::cold]] UNODB_DETAIL_NOINLINE static void dump_node(
1213 std::ostream& os, const NodePtr& node, bool recursive = true) {
1214 os << "node at: " << node.template ptr<void*>() << ", tagged ptr = 0x"
1215 << std::hex << node.raw_val() << std::dec;
1216 if (node == nullptr) {
1217 os << '\n';
1218 return;
1219 }
1220 os << ", type = ";
1221 switch (node.type()) {
1222 case node_type::LEAF:
1223 os << "LEAF";
1224 if constexpr (!can_eliminate_leaf) {
1225 node.template ptr<leaf_type*>()->dump(os, recursive);
1226 }
1227 break;
1228 case node_type::I4:
1229 os << "I4";
1230 node.template ptr<inode4_type*>()->dump(os, recursive);
1231 break;
1232 case node_type::I16:
1233 os << "I16";
1234 node.template ptr<inode16_type*>()->dump(os, recursive);
1235 break;
1236 case node_type::I48:
1237 os << "I48";
1238 node.template ptr<inode48_type*>()->dump(os, recursive);
1239 break;
1240 case node_type::I256:
1241 os << "I256";
1242 node.template ptr<inode256_type*>()->dump(os, recursive);
1243 break;
1244 }
1245 }

1264union [[nodiscard]] key_prefix_snapshot {
1265 // TODO(thompsonbry) Can this be replaced by [using
1266 // key_prefix_snapshot = key_prefix<std::uint64_t,
1267 // in_fake_critical_section>]? We need the snapshot to be

1269 // trivially.]

1272 using key_prefix_data = std::array<std::byte, key_prefix_capacity>;

1275 struct [[nodiscard]] inode_fields {

1279 key_prefix_size key_prefix_length{};
1280 };
1281
1283 inode_fields f;
1285 std::uint64_t u64;

1287 public:
1291 constexpr explicit key_prefix_snapshot(std::uint64_t v) noexcept : u64(v) {}
1292
1296 [[nodiscard]] constexpr key_view get_key_view() const noexcept {
1297 return key_view(f.key_prefix.data(), f.key_prefix_length);
1298 }
1299
1303 [[nodiscard]] constexpr key_prefix_size length() const noexcept {
1304 return f.key_prefix_length;
1305 }
1306
1314 [[nodiscard]] constexpr auto get_shared_length(

1317 }

1323 [[nodiscard]] constexpr auto operator[](std::size_t i) const noexcept {
1324 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(i < length());

1334 [[nodiscard, gnu::const]] static constexpr unsigned shared_len(
1335 std::uint64_t k1, std::uint64_t k2, unsigned clamp_byte_pos) noexcept {
1336 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(clamp_byte_pos < 8);
1337
1338 const auto diff = k1 ^ k2;
1339 const auto clamped = diff | (1ULL << (clamp_byte_pos * 8U));
1340 return static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(clamped) >> 3U);
1341 }

1352template <typename ArtKey, template <class> class CriticalSectionPolicy>
1353union [[nodiscard]] key_prefix {
1354 private:
1357 template <typename, template <class> class>
1358 friend union key_prefix;
1359
1361 template <typename T>
1362 using critical_section_policy = CriticalSectionPolicy<T>;
1363
1365 using key_prefix_data =
1366 std::array<critical_section_policy<std::byte>, key_prefix_capacity>;
1367
1369 struct [[nodiscard]] inode_fields {
1371 key_prefix_data key_prefix;
1373 critical_section_policy<key_prefix_size> key_prefix_length;
1374 };
1375
1377 inode_fields f;
1379 critical_section_policy<std::uint64_t> u64;
1380
1381 public:
1387 key_prefix(key_view k1, ArtKey shifted_k2, tree_depth<ArtKey> depth) noexcept
1388 : u64{make_u64(k1, shifted_k2, depth)} {}
1389
1391 key_prefix(detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len, key_view k1,
1392 tree_depth<ArtKey> depth) noexcept
1393 : u64{make_u64_explicit(prefix_len, k1, depth)} {}
1394
1400 template <template <class> class OtherPolicy>
1401 key_prefix(unsigned key_prefix_len,
1402 const key_prefix<ArtKey, OtherPolicy>& source_key_prefix) noexcept
1403 : u64{(source_key_prefix.u64 & key_bytes_mask) |
1404 length_to_word(key_prefix_len)} {
1405 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(key_prefix_len <= key_prefix_capacity);
1406 }
1407
1409 key_prefix(const key_prefix& other) noexcept : u64{other.u64.load()} {}
1410
1412 ~key_prefix() noexcept = default;
1413
1418 [[nodiscard]] constexpr auto get_shared_length(
1419 ArtKey shifted_key) const noexcept {
1420 return get_shared_length(shifted_key.get_u64());
1421 }
1422
1427 [[nodiscard]] constexpr auto get_shared_length(
1428 std::uint64_t shifted_key_u64) const noexcept {
1429 return shared_len(shifted_key_u64, u64, length());
1430 }
1431
1438 [[nodiscard]] constexpr key_prefix_snapshot get_snapshot() const noexcept {
1439 return key_prefix_snapshot(u64);
1440 }
1441
1445 [[nodiscard]] constexpr key_prefix_size length() const noexcept {
1446 const auto result = f.key_prefix_length.load();
1447 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(result <= key_prefix_capacity);
1448 return result;
1449 }
1450
1454 constexpr void cut(key_prefix_size cut_len) noexcept {
1455 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(cut_len > 0);
1456 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(cut_len <= length());
1457
1458 u64 = ((u64 >> (cut_len * 8)) & key_bytes_mask) |
1459 length_to_word(static_cast<key_prefix_size>(length() - cut_len));
1460
1461 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(f.key_prefix_length.load() <= key_prefix_capacity);
1462 }
1463
1471 template <template <class> class OtherPolicy>
1472 constexpr void prepend(const key_prefix<ArtKey, OtherPolicy>& prefix1,
1473 std::byte prefix2) noexcept {
1474 prepend_impl(prefix1.u64.load(), prefix1.length(), prefix2);
1475 }
1476
1477 private:
1478 constexpr void prepend_impl(std::uint64_t prefix1_u64,
1479 key_prefix_size prefix1_len,
1480 std::byte prefix2) noexcept {
1481 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(length() + prefix1_len < key_prefix_capacity);
1482
1483 const auto prefix1_bit_length = prefix1_len * 8U;
1484 const auto prefix1_mask = (1ULL << prefix1_bit_length) - 1;
1485 const auto prefix3_bit_length = length() * 8U;
1486 const auto prefix3_mask = (1ULL << prefix3_bit_length) - 1;
1487 const auto prefix3 = u64 & prefix3_mask;
1488 const auto shifted_prefix3 = prefix3 << (prefix1_bit_length + 8U);
1489 const auto shifted_prefix2 = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(prefix2)
1490 << prefix1_bit_length;
1491 const auto masked_prefix1 = prefix1_u64 & prefix1_mask;
1492
1493 u64 = shifted_prefix3 | shifted_prefix2 | masked_prefix1 |
1494 length_to_word(length() + prefix1_len + 1U);
1495
1496 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(f.key_prefix_length.load() <= key_prefix_capacity);
1497 }
1498
1499 public:
1504 [[nodiscard]] constexpr auto operator[](std::size_t i) const noexcept {
1505 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(i < length());
1506 return f.key_prefix[i].load();
1507 }
1508
1512 [[gnu::cold]] UNODB_DETAIL_NOINLINE void dump(std::ostream& os) const {
1513 const auto len = length();
1514 os << ", prefix(" << len << ")";
1515 if (len > 0) {
1516 os << ": 0x";
1517 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) dump_byte(os, f.key_prefix[i]);
1518 }
1519 }
1520
1522 key_prefix(key_prefix&&) = delete;
1523
1525 key_prefix& operator=(const key_prefix&) = delete;
1526
1528 key_prefix& operator=(key_prefix&&) = delete;
1529
1530 private:
1532 static constexpr auto key_bytes_mask = 0x00FF'FFFF'FFFF'FFFFULL;
1533
1535 [[nodiscard, gnu::const]] static constexpr std::uint64_t length_to_word(
1536 unsigned length) {
1537 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(length <= key_prefix_capacity);
1538 return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(length) << 56U;
1539 }
1540
1542 [[nodiscard, gnu::const]] static constexpr unsigned shared_len(
1543 std::uint64_t k1, std::uint64_t k2, unsigned clamp_byte_pos) noexcept {
1544 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(clamp_byte_pos < 8);
1545
1546 const auto diff = k1 ^ k2;
1547 const auto clamped = diff | (1ULL << (clamp_byte_pos * 8U));
1548 return static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(clamped) >> 3U);
1549 }
1550
1558 [[nodiscard, gnu::const]] static constexpr std::uint64_t make_u64(
1559 key_view k1, ArtKey shifted_k2, tree_depth<ArtKey> depth) noexcept {
1560 k1 = k1.subspan(depth); // shift_right(depth)
1561
1562 const auto k1_u64 = get_u64(k1) & key_bytes_mask;
1563
1564 return k1_u64 | length_to_word(shared_len(k1_u64, shifted_k2.get_u64(),
1565 key_prefix_capacity));
1566 }
1567
1569 [[nodiscard, gnu::const]] static constexpr std::uint64_t make_u64_explicit(
1570 detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len, key_view k1,
1571 tree_depth<ArtKey> depth) noexcept {
1572 k1 = k1.subspan(depth);
1573 const auto k1_u64 = get_u64(k1) & key_bytes_mask;
1574 return k1_u64 | length_to_word(prefix_len);
1575 }
1576}; // class key_prefix

2575 const auto child_ptr = children[child_to_leave].load();
2576 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
2577 if (is_value_in_slot(child_to_leave)) return false;
2578 }
2579 if (child_ptr.type() == node_type::LEAF) {
2580 // For keyless leaves, collapsing would lose key bytes encoded
2581 // in this inode's prefix+dispatch. Keep the chain intact.
2582 return !ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_key_in_leaf;
2583 }
2584 const auto* const child_inode{child_ptr.template ptr<inode_type*>()};
2585 return this->get_key_prefix().length() +
2586 child_inode->get_key_prefix().length() <
2587 detail::key_prefix_capacity;
2588 }

2659 constexpr void init(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
2660 inode16_type& source_node, std::uint8_t child_to_delete) {
2661 const auto reclaim_source_node{
2662 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode16_type>(
2663 &source_node, db_instance)};
2664 auto source_keys_itr = source_node.keys.byte_array.cbegin();
2665 auto keys_itr = keys.byte_array.begin();
2666 auto source_children_itr = source_node.children.cbegin();
2667 auto children_itr = children.begin();
2668
2669 while (source_keys_itr !=
2670 source_node.keys.byte_array.cbegin() + child_to_delete) {
2671 *keys_itr++ = *source_keys_itr++;
2672 *children_itr++ = *source_children_itr++;
2673 }
2674
2675 [[maybe_unused]] const auto r{
2676 ArtPolicy::reclaim_if_leaf(source_children_itr->load(), db_instance)};
2677
2678 ++source_keys_itr;
2679 ++source_children_itr;
2680
2681 while (source_keys_itr !=
2682 source_node.keys.byte_array.cbegin() + inode16_type::min_size) {
2683 *keys_itr++ = *source_keys_itr++;
2684 *children_itr++ = *source_children_itr++;
2685 }

2687 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->children_count == basic_inode_4::capacity);
2688 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
2689 std::is_sorted(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
2690 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + basic_inode_4::capacity));
2691
2692 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
2693 std::uint8_t dst = 0;
2694 for (std::uint8_t src = 0; src < inode16_type::min_size; ++src) {
2695 if (src == child_to_delete) continue;
2696 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot(src)) set_value_bit(dst);
2697 ++dst;

2747 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(db_leaf_unique_ptr&& child,
2748 // cppcheck-suppress passedByValue
2749 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
2750 std::byte key_byte,
2751 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
2752 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ == this->children_count);
2753 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < parent_class::capacity);
2754 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
2755 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
2756
2757 const auto kb = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte);
2758#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
2759 const auto mask = (1U << children_count_) - 1;
2760 const auto insert_pos_index = get_insert_pos(kb, mask);
2761#else
2762 // This is also currently the best ARM implementation.
2763 const auto first_lt = ((keys.integer & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
2764 const auto second_lt = (((keys.integer >> 8U) & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
2765 const auto third_lt = ((keys.integer >> 16U) & 0xFFU) < kb ? 1 : 0;
2766 const auto insert_pos_index =
2767 static_cast<unsigned>(first_lt + second_lt + third_lt);
2768#endif
2769
2770 for (typename decltype(keys.byte_array)::size_type i = children_count_;
2771 i > insert_pos_index; --i) {
2772 keys.byte_array[i] = keys.byte_array[i - 1];
2773 children[i] = children[i - 1];
2774 }
2775 keys.byte_array[insert_pos_index] = key_byte;
2776 children[insert_pos_index] = node_ptr{child.release(), node_type::LEAF};
2777
2778 // Shift value bitmask to match shifted children array.
2779 // The new entry is a leaf (not a packed value), so no bit is set for it.
2780 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
2781 bitmask_base::insert_at(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
2782 }
2783
2784 ++children_count_;
2785 this->children_count = children_count_;
2786
2787 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
2788 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
2789 }

2792 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(node_ptr packed_value,
2793 // cppcheck-suppress passedByValue
2794 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
2795 std::byte key_byte,
2796 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
2797 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ == this->children_count);
2798 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < parent_class::capacity);
2799
2800 const auto kb = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte);
2801#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
2802 const auto mask = (1U << children_count_) - 1;
2803 const auto insert_pos_index = get_insert_pos(kb, mask);
2804#else
2805 const auto first_lt = ((keys.integer & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
2806 const auto second_lt = (((keys.integer >> 8U) & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
2807 const auto third_lt = ((keys.integer >> 16U) & 0xFFU) < kb ? 1 : 0;
2808 const auto insert_pos_index =
2809 static_cast<unsigned>(first_lt + second_lt + third_lt);
2810#endif
2811
2812 for (typename decltype(keys.byte_array)::size_type i = children_count_;
2813 i > insert_pos_index; --i) {
2814 keys.byte_array[i] = keys.byte_array[i - 1];
2815 children[i] = children[i - 1];
2816 }
2817 keys.byte_array[insert_pos_index] = key_byte;
2818 children[insert_pos_index] = packed_value;
2819 // Shift existing value bits to match shifted children, then set new bit.
2820 bitmask_base::insert_at(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
2821 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
2822
2823 ++children_count_;
2824 this->children_count = children_count_;
2825 }

2927 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] find_result find_child(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
2928#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
2929 const auto replicated_search_key =
2930 _mm_set1_epi8(static_cast<char>(key_byte));
2931 const auto keys_in_sse_reg =
2932 _mm_cvtsi32_si128(static_cast<std::int32_t>(keys.integer.load()));
2933 const auto matching_key_positions =
2934 _mm_cmpeq_epi8(replicated_search_key, keys_in_sse_reg);
2935 const auto mask = (1U << this->children_count.load()) - 1;
2936 const auto bit_field =
2937 static_cast<unsigned>(_mm_movemask_epi8(matching_key_positions)) & mask;
2938 if (bit_field != 0) {
2939 const auto i = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(std::countr_zero(bit_field));
2940 return std::make_pair(
2941 i, static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[i]));
2942 }
2943 return parent_class::child_not_found;
2944#elif defined(__aarch64__)
2945 const auto replicated_search_key =
2946 vdupq_n_u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte));
2947 const auto keys_in_neon_reg = vreinterpretq_u8_u32(
2948 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
2949 vsetq_lane_u32(keys.integer.load(), vdupq_n_u32(0), 0));
2950 const auto mask = (1ULL << (this->children_count.load() << 3U)) - 1;
2951 const auto matching_key_positions =
2952 vceqq_u8(replicated_search_key, keys_in_neon_reg);
2953 const auto u64_pos_in_vec =
2954 vget_low_u64(vreinterpretq_u64_u8(matching_key_positions));
2955 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
2956 const auto pos_in_scalar = vget_lane_u64(u64_pos_in_vec, 0);
2957 const auto masked_pos = pos_in_scalar & mask;
2958
2959 if (masked_pos == 0) return parent_class::child_not_found;
2960
2961 const auto i = static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(masked_pos) >> 3U);
2962 return std::make_pair(
2963 i, static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[i]));
2964#else // #ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
2965 // Bit twiddling:
2966 // contains_byte: std::countr_zero: for key index:
2967 // 0x80000000 0x1F 3
2968 // 0x800000 0x17 2
2969 // 0x8000 0x0F 1
2970 // 0x80 0x07 0
2971 // 0x0 UB (check!) not found
2972 const auto match = contains_byte(keys.integer, key_byte);
2973 if (match == 0) return parent_class::child_not_found;
2974
2975 const auto result =
2976 static_cast<typename decltype(keys.byte_array)::size_type>(
2977 std::countr_zero(match) >> 3U);
2978
2979 // The condition could be replaced with masking, but this seems to result
2980 // in a benchmark regression
2981 if (result >= this->children_count.load())
2982 return parent_class::child_not_found;
2983
2984 return std::make_pair(
2985 result,
2986 static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[result]));
2987#endif // #ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
2988 }

3006 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result
3007 begin() noexcept {

3016 // TODO(laurynas) The iter_result-returning sequences follow the
3017 // same pattern once child_index is known. Look into extracting a

3019 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result
3020 last() noexcept {
3021 const auto child_index{
3022 static_cast<std::uint8_t>(this->children_count.load() - 1)};
3023 const auto key = keys.byte_array[child_index].load();
3024 return {node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, child_index,

3033 // TODO(laurynas) explore 1) branchless 2) SIMD implementations for
3034 // begin(), last(), next(), prior(), get_key_byte(), and
3035 // lte_key_byte(). next() and begin() will be the most frequently
3036 // invoked methods (assuming forward traversal), so that would be
3037 // the place to start. The GTE and LTE methods are only used by
3038 // seek() so they are relatively rarely invoked. Look at each of the
3039 // inode types when doing this.
3040 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result_opt
3041 next(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
3042 const auto nchildren{this->children_count.load()};
3043 const auto next_index{static_cast<uint8_t>(child_index + 1)};
3044 if (next_index >= nchildren) return parent_class::end_result;
3045 const auto key = keys.byte_array[next_index].load();
3046 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, next_index,
3047 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
3048 }

3056 prior(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {

3058 const auto next_index{static_cast<std::uint8_t>(child_index - 1)};
3059 const auto key = keys.byte_array[next_index].load();
3060 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, next_index,

3069 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result_opt
3070 gte_key_byte(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3071 const auto nchildren{this->children_count.load()};
3072 for (std::uint8_t i = 0; i < nchildren; ++i) {
3073 const auto key = keys.byte_array[i].load();
3074 if (key >= key_byte) {
3075 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, i,
3076 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
3077 }
3078 }
3079 // This should only occur if there is no entry in the keys[] which
3080 // is greater-than the given [key_byte].
3081 return parent_class::end_result;
3082 }

3089 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_4::iter_result_opt
3090 lte_key_byte(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3091 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3092 for (std::int64_t i = children_count_ - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
3093 const auto child_index = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
3094 const auto key = keys.byte_array[child_index].load();
3095 if (key <= key_byte) {
3096 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I4}, key, child_index,
3097 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
3098 }
3099 }
3100 // The first key in the node is GT the given key_byte.
3101 return parent_class::end_result;
3102 }

3145 private:
3152 constexpr void add_two_to_empty(std::byte key1, node_ptr child1,
3153 std::byte key2,
3154 db_leaf_unique_ptr child2) noexcept {
3155 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(key1 != key2);
3156 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->children_count == 2);
3157
3158 const std::uint8_t key1_i = key1 < key2 ? 0U : 1U;
3159 const std::uint8_t key2_i = 1U - key1_i;
3160 keys.byte_array[key1_i] = key1;
3161 children[key1_i] = child1;
3162 keys.byte_array[key2_i] = key2;
3163 children[key2_i] = node_ptr{child2.release(), node_type::LEAF};
3164#ifndef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3165 keys.byte_array[2] = unused_key_byte;
3166 keys.byte_array[3] = unused_key_byte;
3167#endif
3168
3169 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
3170 std::is_sorted(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
3171 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + this->children_count));
3172 }
3173
3175 constexpr void add_two_to_empty(std::byte key1, node_ptr child1,
3176 std::byte key2, node_ptr child2) noexcept {
3177 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(key1 != key2);
3178 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->children_count == 2);
3179
3180 const std::uint8_t key1_i = key1 < key2 ? 0U : 1U;
3181 const std::uint8_t key2_i = 1U - key1_i;
3182 keys.byte_array[key1_i] = key1;
3183 children[key1_i] = child1;
3184 keys.byte_array[key2_i] = key2;
3185 children[key2_i] = child2;
3186 // child2 is always a packed value in the value-in-slot path.
3187 // child1 may be an inode (existing subtree) or a packed value.
3188 set_value_bit(key2_i);
3189#ifndef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3190 keys.byte_array[2] = unused_key_byte;
3191 keys.byte_array[3] = unused_key_byte;
3192#endif
3193
3194 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
3195 std::is_sorted(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
3196 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + this->children_count));
3197 }
3198
3200 union key_union {
3202 std::array<critical_section_policy<std::byte>, basic_inode_4::capacity>
3203 byte_array;
3205 critical_section_policy<std::uint32_t> integer;
3206
3208 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26495)
3209 constexpr key_union() noexcept {}
3210 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
3211 };
3212
3214 public:
3215 [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool is_value_in_slot(std::uint8_t i) const noexcept {
3216 return bitmask_base::test(i);
3217 }
3219 constexpr void set_value_bit(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
3220 bitmask_base::set(i);
3221 }
3223 constexpr void clear_value_bit(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
3224 bitmask_base::clear(i);
3225 }
3226
3228 key_union keys;
3229
3230 static_assert(std::alignment_of_v<decltype(keys)> == 4);
3231 static_assert(sizeof(keys) == 4);
3232
3233 protected:
3235 std::array<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>, basic_inode_4::capacity>
3236 children;
3237
3238 static_assert(sizeof(children) == 32);
3239
3240 private:
3241#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3248 [[nodiscard]] auto get_insert_pos(std::uint8_t insert_key_byte,
3249 unsigned node_key_mask) const noexcept {
3250 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(node_key_mask ==
3251 (1U << this->children_count.load()) - 1);
3252
3253 const auto replicated_insert_key_byte =
3254 _mm_set1_epi8(static_cast<char>(insert_key_byte));
3255 const auto node_keys_in_sse_reg =
3256 _mm_cvtsi32_si128(static_cast<std::int32_t>(keys.integer.load()));
3257 // Since the existing and insert key values cannot be equal, it's OK to use
3258 // "<=" comparison as "<".
3259 const auto le_node_key_positions =
3260 _mm_cmple_epu8(node_keys_in_sse_reg, replicated_insert_key_byte);
3261 const auto bit_field =
3262 static_cast<unsigned>(_mm_movemask_epi8(le_node_key_positions)) &
3263 node_key_mask;
3264 return static_cast<unsigned>(std::popcount(bit_field));
3265 }
3266#else
3268 static constexpr std::byte unused_key_byte{0xFF};
3269#endif

3271 template <class>
3272 friend class basic_inode_16;
3273 friend class basic_inode_impl<ArtPolicy>;
3274
3275 public:
3286 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_CLANG_21_WARNING("-Wnrvo")
3287 [[nodiscard]] static auto create_bulk(
3288 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
3289 detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len, unodb::key_view prefix_key,
3290 tree_depth_type depth,
3291 std::span<const detail::bulk_child<node_ptr>> children_span,
3292 std::uint8_t value_mask = 0) {
3293 const auto n = static_cast<unsigned>(children_span.size());
3294 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(n >= 2 && n <= 4);
3295 auto result =
3296 inode4_type::create(db_instance, n, prefix_len, prefix_key, depth,
3297 typename parent_class::bulk_load_tag{});
3298 auto* node = result.get();
3299 for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
3300 node->keys.byte_array[i] = children_span[i].key_byte;
3301 node->children[i] = children_span[i].child;
3302 }
3303#ifndef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3304 for (unsigned i = n; i < 4; ++i) node->keys.byte_array[i] = unused_key_byte;
3305#endif
3306 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3307 node->bitmask_base::bits = value_mask;
3308 }
3309 return result;
3310 }
3311 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_CLANG_21_WARNINGS()

3416 constexpr void init(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
3417 inode4_type& source_node, db_leaf_unique_ptr child,
3418 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
3419 std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3420 // This overload is only for trees with actual leaves. When
3421 // can_eliminate_leaf is true, init_grow unconditionally sets the
3422 // value bit — which is correct because only the packed-value
3423 // overload below can be called in that mode.
3424 static_assert(!ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf,
3425 "leaf init must not be called when leaves are eliminated");
3426 init_grow(db_instance, source_node,
3427 node_ptr{child.release(), node_type::LEAF}, key_byte);
3428 }

3431 constexpr void init(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
3432 inode4_type& source_node, node_ptr packed_value,
3433 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
3434 std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3435 init_grow(db_instance, source_node, packed_value, key_byte);

3437
3439 constexpr void init_grow(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
3440 inode4_type& source_node, node_ptr child_val,
3441 std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3442 const auto reclaim_source_node{
3443 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode4_type>(
3444 &source_node, db_instance)};
3445 const auto kb = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte);
3446
3447#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3448 const auto insert_pos_index = source_node.get_insert_pos(kb, 0xFU);
3449#else
3450 const auto keys_integer = source_node.keys.integer.load();
3451 const auto first_lt = ((keys_integer & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
3452 const auto second_lt = (((keys_integer >> 8U) & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
3453 const auto third_lt = (((keys_integer >> 16U) & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
3454 const auto fourth_lt = (((keys_integer >> 24U) & 0xFFU) < kb) ? 1 : 0;
3455 const auto insert_pos_index =
3456 static_cast<unsigned>(first_lt + second_lt + third_lt + fourth_lt);
3457#endif
3458
3459 unsigned i = 0;
3460 for (; i < insert_pos_index; ++i) {
3461 keys.byte_array[i] = source_node.keys.byte_array[i];
3462 children[i] = source_node.children[i];
3463 }
3464
3465 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSUME(i < parent_class::capacity);
3466
3467 keys.byte_array[i] = key_byte;
3468 children[i] = child_val;
3469 ++i;
3470
3471 for (; i <= inode4_type::capacity; ++i) {
3472 keys.byte_array[i] = source_node.keys.byte_array[i - 1];
3473 children[i] = source_node.children[i - 1];
3474 }
3475
3476 // Copy value bitmask from source, inserting the new child's bit.
3477 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3478 for (unsigned j = 0; j < insert_pos_index; ++j) {
3479 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j)))
3480 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j));
3481 }
3482 // The new child at insert_pos_index is a packed value
3483 // (this overload is only called for value-in-slot).
3484 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
3485 for (unsigned j = insert_pos_index; j < inode4_type::capacity; ++j) {
3486 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j)))
3487 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j + 1));
3488 }
3489 }
3490 }
3491
3497 constexpr void init(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
3498 inode48_type& source_node,
3499 std::uint8_t child_to_delete) noexcept {
3500 const auto reclaim_source_node{
3501 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode48_type>(
3502 &source_node, db_instance)};
3503 source_node.remove_child_pointer(child_to_delete, db_instance);
3504 source_node.child_indexes[child_to_delete] = inode48_type::empty_child;
3505
3506 // TODO(laurynas): consider AVX2 gather?
3507 unsigned next_child = 0;
3508 unsigned i = 0;
3509 while (true) {
3510 const auto source_child_i = source_node.child_indexes[i].load();
3511 if (source_child_i != inode48_type::empty_child) {
3512 keys.byte_array[next_child] = static_cast<std::byte>(i);
3513 const auto source_child_ptr =
3514 source_node.children.pointer_array[source_child_i].load();
3515 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(source_child_ptr != nullptr ||
3516 source_node.is_value_in_slot_by_ci(source_child_i));
3517 children[next_child] = source_child_ptr;
3518 ++next_child;
3519 if (next_child == basic_inode_16::capacity) break;
3520 }
3521 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(i < 255);
3522 ++i;
3523 }
3524
3525 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->children_count == basic_inode_16::capacity);
3526 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
3527 std::is_sorted(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
3528 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + basic_inode_16::capacity));
3529
3530 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3531 // Copy bitmask from I48. I48 uses slot indices; we mapped them
3532 // to sequential positions in the loop above. Re-scan to set bits.
3533 next_child = 0;
3534 for (unsigned j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
3535 const auto sci = source_node.child_indexes[j].load();
3536 if (sci != inode48_type::empty_child) {
3537 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot_by_ci(sci))
3538 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(next_child));
3539 ++next_child;
3540 if (next_child == basic_inode_16::capacity) break;
3541 }
3542 }
3543 }
3544 }

3554 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(db_leaf_unique_ptr&& child,
3555 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
3556 std::byte key_byte,
3557 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
3558 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ == this->children_count);
3559 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < parent_class::capacity);
3560 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
3561 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
3562
3563 const auto insert_pos_index =
3564 get_sorted_key_array_insert_position(key_byte);
3565
3566 if (insert_pos_index != children_count_) {
3567 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(insert_pos_index < children_count_);
3568 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(keys.byte_array[insert_pos_index] != key_byte);
3569
3570 std::copy_backward(keys.byte_array.cbegin() + insert_pos_index,
3571 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_,
3572 keys.byte_array.begin() + children_count_ + 1);
3573 std::copy_backward(children.begin() + insert_pos_index,
3574 children.begin() + children_count_,
3575 children.begin() + children_count_ + 1);
3576 }
3577
3578 keys.byte_array[insert_pos_index] = key_byte;
3579 children[insert_pos_index] = node_ptr{child.release(), node_type::LEAF};
3580 // Shift value bitmask to match shifted children array.
3581 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3582 bitmask_base::insert_at(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
3583 }
3584 ++children_count_;
3585 this->children_count = children_count_;
3586
3587 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
3588 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
3589 }
3590
3592 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(node_ptr packed_value,
3593 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
3594 std::byte key_byte,
3595 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
3596 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ == this->children_count);
3597 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < parent_class::capacity);
3598 const auto insert_pos_index =
3599 get_sorted_key_array_insert_position(key_byte);
3600 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSUME(insert_pos_index < parent_class::capacity);
3601 if (insert_pos_index != children_count_) {
3602 std::copy_backward(keys.byte_array.cbegin() + insert_pos_index,
3603 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_,
3604 keys.byte_array.begin() + children_count_ + 1);
3605 std::copy_backward(children.begin() + insert_pos_index,
3606 children.begin() + children_count_,
3607 children.begin() + children_count_ + 1);
3608 }
3609 keys.byte_array[insert_pos_index] = key_byte;
3610 children[insert_pos_index] = packed_value;
3611 // Shift existing value bits to match shifted children, then set new bit.
3612 bitmask_base::insert_at(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
3613 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(insert_pos_index));
3614 ++children_count_;
3615 this->children_count = children_count_;
3616 }

3622 // MSVC C26815 false positive: reclaim object intentionally destroyed at
3623 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26460)
3624 // scope exit while db_instance (passed by caller) remains valid.
3625 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26815)
3626 constexpr void remove(
3627 std::uint8_t child_index,
3628 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance) noexcept {
3629 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(child_index < this->children_count.load());
3630
3631 if constexpr (!ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3632 const auto r{ArtPolicy::reclaim_leaf_on_scope_exit(
3633 children[child_index].load().template ptr<leaf_type*>(),
3634 db_instance)};
3635 }
3636
3637 remove_child_entry(child_index);
3638 }
3639
3643 constexpr void remove_child_entry(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
3644 auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3645 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(child_index < children_count_);
3646 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
3647 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
3648
3649 for (unsigned i = child_index + 1U; i < children_count_; ++i) {
3650 keys.byte_array[i - 1] = keys.byte_array[i];
3651 children[i - 1] = children[i];
3652 }
3653
3654 --children_count_;
3655 this->children_count = children_count_;
3656
3657 // Shift bitmask bits to match shifted children array.
3658 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3659 bitmask_base::remove_at(child_index);
3660 }
3661
3662 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
3663 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
3664 }

3673 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr find_result find_child(
3674 std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3675#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3676 const auto replicated_search_key =
3677 _mm_set1_epi8(static_cast<char>(key_byte));
3678 const auto matching_key_positions =
3679 _mm_cmpeq_epi8(replicated_search_key, keys.byte_vector);
3680 const auto mask = (1U << this->children_count) - 1;
3681 const auto bit_field =
3682 static_cast<unsigned>(_mm_movemask_epi8(matching_key_positions)) & mask;
3683 if (bit_field != 0) {
3684 const auto i = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(std::countr_zero(bit_field));
3685 return std::make_pair(
3686 i, static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[i]));
3687 }
3688 return parent_class::child_not_found;
3689#elif defined(__aarch64__)
3690 const auto replicated_search_key =
3691 vdupq_n_u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte));
3692 const auto matching_key_positions =
3693 vceqq_u8(replicated_search_key, keys.byte_vector);
3694 const auto narrowed_positions =
3695 vshrn_n_u16(vreinterpretq_u16_u8(matching_key_positions), 4);
3696 const auto scalar_pos =
3697 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
3698 vget_lane_u64(vreinterpret_u64_u8(narrowed_positions), 0);
3699 const auto child_count = this->children_count.load();
3700 const auto mask = (child_count == 16) ? 0xFFFFFFFF'FFFFFFFFULL
3701 : (1ULL << (child_count << 2U)) - 1;
3702 const auto masked_pos = scalar_pos & mask;
3703
3704 if (masked_pos == 0) return parent_class::child_not_found;
3705
3706 const auto i = static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(masked_pos) >> 2U);
3707 return std::make_pair(
3708 i, static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[i]));
3709#else
3710 for (size_t i = 0; i < this->children_count.load(); ++i)
3711 if (key_byte == keys.byte_array[i])
3712 return std::make_pair(
3713 i, static_cast<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>*>(&children[i]));
3714 return parent_class::child_not_found;
3715#endif
3716 }
3717
3726 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr node_ptr get_child(
3727 std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
3728 return children[child_index].load();

3734 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result
3735 begin() noexcept {
3736 const auto key = keys.byte_array[0].load();
3737 return {node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, 0,
3738 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()};
3739 }
3740
3744 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result
3745 last() noexcept {
3746 const auto child_index{
3747 static_cast<std::uint8_t>(this->children_count.load() - 1)};
3748 const auto key = keys.byte_array[child_index].load();
3749 return {node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, child_index,
3750 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()};
3751 }
3752
3758 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result_opt
3759 next(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
3760 const auto nchildren{this->children_count.load()};
3761 const auto next_index{static_cast<std::uint8_t>(child_index + 1)};
3762 if (next_index >= nchildren) return parent_class::end_result;
3763 const auto key = keys.byte_array[next_index].load();
3764 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, next_index,
3765 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
3766 }
3767
3773 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result_opt
3774 prior(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
3775 if (child_index == 0) return parent_class::end_result;
3776 const auto next_index{static_cast<std::uint8_t>(child_index - 1)};
3777 const auto key = keys.byte_array[next_index].load();
3778 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, next_index,
3779 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
3780 }
3781
3787 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result_opt
3788 lte_key_byte(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3789 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3790 for (std::int64_t i = children_count_ - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
3791 const auto child_index = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
3792 const auto key = keys.byte_array[child_index].load();
3793 if (key <= key_byte) {
3794 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, child_index,
3795 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
3796 }
3797 }
3798 // The first key in the node is GT the given key_byte.
3799 return parent_class::end_result;
3800 }
3801
3807 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_16::iter_result_opt
3808 gte_key_byte(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3809 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3810 for (std::uint8_t i = 0; i < children_count_; ++i) {
3811 const auto key = keys.byte_array[i].load();
3812 if (key >= key_byte) {
3813 return {{node_ptr{this, node_type::I16}, key, i,
3814 this->get_key_prefix().get_snapshot()}};
3815 }
3816 }
3817 // This should only occur if there is no entry in the keys[] which
3818 // is greater-than the given [key_byte].
3819 return parent_class::end_result;
3820 }

3825 constexpr void delete_subtree(
3826 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance) noexcept {
3827 const uint8_t children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3828 for (std::uint8_t i = 0; i < children_count_; ++i) {
3829 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3830 if (is_value_in_slot(i)) continue;
3831 }
3832 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(children[i], db_instance);
3833 }
3834 }
3835
3840 [[gnu::cold]] UNODB_DETAIL_NOINLINE void dump(std::ostream& os,
3841 bool recursive) const {
3842 parent_class::dump(os, recursive);
3843 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3844 os << ", key bytes =";
3845 for (std::uint8_t i = 0; i < children_count_; ++i)
3846 dump_byte(os, keys.byte_array[i]);
3847 if (recursive) {
3848 os << ", children: \n";
3849 for (std::uint8_t i = 0; i < children_count_; ++i) {
3850 if (is_value_in_slot(i)) {
3851 os << " [" << static_cast<unsigned>(i) << "] value=";
3852 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3853 os << ArtPolicy::unpack_value(children[i].load());
3854 }
3855 os << "\n";
3856 } else {
3857 ArtPolicy::dump_node(os, children[i].load());
3858 }
3859 }
3860 }
3861 }
3862
3863 private:
3869 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr auto get_sorted_key_array_insert_position(
3870 std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
3871 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
3872
3873 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < basic_inode_16::capacity);
3874 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(std::is_sorted(
3875 keys.byte_array.cbegin(), keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_));
3876 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
3877 std::adjacent_find(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
3878 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_) >=
3879 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_);
3880
3881#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3882 const auto replicated_insert_key =
3883 _mm_set1_epi8(static_cast<char>(key_byte));
3884 const auto lesser_key_positions =
3885 _mm_cmple_epu8(replicated_insert_key, keys.byte_vector);
3886 const auto mask = (1U << children_count_) - 1;
3887 const auto bit_field =
3888 static_cast<unsigned>(_mm_movemask_epi8(lesser_key_positions)) & mask;
3889 const auto result =
3890 (bit_field != 0)
3891 ? static_cast<std::uint8_t>(std::countr_zero(bit_field))
3892 : static_cast<std::uint8_t>(children_count_);
3893#else
3894 // This is also the best current ARM implementation
3895 const auto result = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(
3896 std::lower_bound(keys.byte_array.cbegin(),
3897 keys.byte_array.cbegin() + children_count_, key_byte) -
3898 keys.byte_array.cbegin());
3899#endif
3900
3901 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
3902 result == children_count_ ||
3903 (result < children_count_ && keys.byte_array[result] != key_byte));
3904 return result;
3905 }
3906
3907 protected:
3909 union key_union {
3911 std::array<critical_section_policy<std::byte>, basic_inode_16::capacity>
3912 byte_array;
3913#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
3915 __m128i byte_vector;
3916#elif defined(__aarch64__)
3918 uint8x16_t byte_vector;
3919#endif
3921 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26495)
3922 key_union() noexcept {}
3923 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
3924 };

3926 public:
3928 [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool is_value_in_slot(std::uint8_t i) const noexcept {
3929 return bitmask_base::test(i);
3930 }
3932 constexpr void set_value_bit(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
3933 bitmask_base::set(i);
3934 }
3936 constexpr void clear_value_bit(std::uint8_t i) noexcept {
3937 bitmask_base::clear(i);
3938 }
3939
3941 key_union keys;
3942
3944 std::array<critical_section_policy<node_ptr>, basic_inode_16::capacity>
3945 children;

3948 template <class>
3949 friend class basic_inode_4;

3951 template <class>
3952 friend class basic_inode_48;

3954 public:
3959 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_CLANG_21_WARNING("-Wnrvo")
3960 [[nodiscard]] static auto create_bulk(
3961 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
3962 detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len, unodb::key_view prefix_key,
3963 tree_depth_type depth,
3964 std::span<const detail::bulk_child<node_ptr>> children_span,
3965 std::uint16_t value_mask = 0) {
3966 const auto n = static_cast<unsigned>(children_span.size());
3967 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(n >= 5 && n <= 16);
3968 auto result =
3969 inode16_type::create(db_instance, n, prefix_len, prefix_key, depth,
3970 typename parent_class::bulk_load_tag{});
3971 auto* node = result.get();
3972 for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
3973 node->keys.byte_array[i] = children_span[i].key_byte;
3974 node->children[i] = children_span[i].child;
3975 }
3976 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
3977 node->bitmask_base::bits = value_mask;
3978 }
3979 return result;
3980 }
3981 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_CLANG_21_WARNINGS()

4110 constexpr void init_grow(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
4111 inode16_type& __restrict source_node,
4112 node_ptr child_val, std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
4113 const auto reclaim_source_node{
4114 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode16_type>(
4115 &source_node, db_instance)};
4116
4117 std::uint8_t i = 0;
4118 for (; i < inode16_type::capacity; ++i) {
4119 const auto existing_key_byte = source_node.keys.byte_array[i].load();
4120 child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(existing_key_byte)] = i;
4121 }
4122 for (i = 0; i < inode16_type::capacity; ++i) {
4123 children.pointer_array[i] = source_node.children[i];
4124 }
4125
4126 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] ==
4127 empty_child);
4128 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSUME(i == inode16_type::capacity);
4129
4130 child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] = i;
4131 children.pointer_array[i] = child_val;
4132 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4133 // Copy bitmask from source I16 (indexed by position).
4134 for (std::uint8_t j = 0; j < inode16_type::capacity; ++j) {
4135 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot(j)) set_value_bit_by_ci(j);
4136 }
4137 // The new child is a packed value.
4138 set_value_bit_by_ci(i);
4139 }
4140 for (i = this->children_count; i < basic_inode_48::capacity; i++) {
4141 children.pointer_array[i] = node_ptr{nullptr};
4142 }
4143 }
4144
4150 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26460)
4151 // MSVC C26815 false positive: reclaim objects intentionally destroyed at
4152 // scope exit while db_instance (passed by caller) remains valid.
4153 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26815)
4154 constexpr void init(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
4155 inode256_type& __restrict source_node,
4156 std::uint8_t child_to_delete) noexcept {
4157 const auto reclaim_source_node{
4158 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode256_type>(
4159 &source_node, db_instance)};
4160 [[maybe_unused]] const auto r{ArtPolicy::reclaim_if_leaf(
4161 source_node.children[child_to_delete].load(), db_instance)};
4162
4163 source_node.children[child_to_delete] = node_ptr{nullptr};
4164 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4165 source_node.clear_value_bit(child_to_delete);
4166 }
4167
4168 std::uint8_t next_child = 0;
4169 for (unsigned child_i = 0; child_i < 256; child_i++) {
4170 const auto child_ptr = source_node.children[child_i].load();
4171 if (child_ptr == nullptr &&
4172 !(ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf &&
4173 source_node.is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(child_i))))
4174 continue;
4175
4176 child_indexes[child_i] = next_child;
4177 children.pointer_array[next_child] = source_node.children[child_i].load();
4178 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4179 if (source_node.is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(child_i)))
4180 set_value_bit_by_ci(next_child);
4181 }
4182 ++next_child;
4183
4184 if (next_child == basic_inode_48::capacity) return;
4185 }
4186 }
4187 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()
4188 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_MSVC_WARNINGS()

4198 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(db_leaf_unique_ptr&& child,
4199 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
4200 std::byte key_byte,
4201 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
4202 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(this->children_count == children_count_);
4203 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ >= parent_class::min_size);
4204 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < parent_class::capacity);
4205
4206 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] ==
4207 empty_child);
4208 unsigned i{0};
4209#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_SSE4_2
4210 const auto nullptr_vector = _mm_setzero_si128();
4211 while (true) {
4212 const auto ptr_vec0 = _mm_load_si128(&children.pointer_vector[i]);
4213 const auto ptr_vec1 = _mm_load_si128(&children.pointer_vector[i + 1]);
4214 const auto ptr_vec2 = _mm_load_si128(&children.pointer_vector[i + 2]);
4215 const auto ptr_vec3 = _mm_load_si128(&children.pointer_vector[i + 3]);
4216 const auto vec0_cmp = _mm_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec0, nullptr_vector);
4217 const auto vec1_cmp = _mm_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec1, nullptr_vector);
4218 const auto vec2_cmp = _mm_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec2, nullptr_vector);
4219 const auto vec3_cmp = _mm_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec3, nullptr_vector);
4220 // OK to treat 64-bit comparison result as 32-bit vector: we need to find
4221 // the first 0xFF only.
4222 const auto vec01_cmp = _mm_packs_epi32(vec0_cmp, vec1_cmp);
4223 const auto vec23_cmp = _mm_packs_epi32(vec2_cmp, vec3_cmp);
4224 const auto vec_cmp = _mm_packs_epi32(vec01_cmp, vec23_cmp);
4225 const auto cmp_mask =
4226 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(_mm_movemask_epi8(vec_cmp));
4227 if (cmp_mask != 0) {
4228 i = (i << 1U) +
4229 ((static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(cmp_mask)) + 1U) >> 1U);
4230 break;
4231 }
4232 i += 4;
4233 }
4234#elif defined(UNODB_DETAIL_AVX2)
4235 const auto nullptr_vector = _mm256_setzero_si256();
4236 while (true) {
4237 const auto ptr_vec0 = _mm256_load_si256(&children.pointer_vector[i]);
4238 const auto ptr_vec1 = _mm256_load_si256(&children.pointer_vector[i + 1]);
4239 const auto ptr_vec2 = _mm256_load_si256(&children.pointer_vector[i + 2]);
4240 const auto ptr_vec3 = _mm256_load_si256(&children.pointer_vector[i + 3]);
4241 const auto vec0_cmp = _mm256_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec0, nullptr_vector);
4242 const auto vec1_cmp = _mm256_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec1, nullptr_vector);
4243 const auto vec2_cmp = _mm256_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec2, nullptr_vector);
4244 const auto vec3_cmp = _mm256_cmpeq_epi64(ptr_vec3, nullptr_vector);
4245 const auto interleaved_vec01_cmp = _mm256_packs_epi32(vec0_cmp, vec1_cmp);
4246 const auto interleaved_vec23_cmp = _mm256_packs_epi32(vec2_cmp, vec3_cmp);
4247 const auto doubly_interleaved_vec_cmp =
4248 _mm256_packs_epi32(interleaved_vec01_cmp, interleaved_vec23_cmp);
4249 if (!_mm256_testz_si256(doubly_interleaved_vec_cmp,
4250 doubly_interleaved_vec_cmp)) {
4251 const auto vec01_cmp =
4252 _mm256_permute4x64_epi64(interleaved_vec01_cmp, 0b11'01'10'00);
4253 const auto vec23_cmp =
4254 _mm256_permute4x64_epi64(interleaved_vec23_cmp, 0b11'01'10'00);
4255 const auto interleaved_vec_cmp =
4256 _mm256_packs_epi32(vec01_cmp, vec23_cmp);
4257 const auto vec_cmp =
4258 _mm256_permute4x64_epi64(interleaved_vec_cmp, 0b11'01'10'00);
4259 const auto cmp_mask =
4260 static_cast<std::uint64_t>(_mm256_movemask_epi8(vec_cmp));
4261 i = (i << 2U) +
4262 (static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(cmp_mask)) >> 1U);
4263 break;
4264 }
4265 i += 4;
4266 }
4267#elif defined(__aarch64__)
4268 const auto nullptr_vector = vdupq_n_u64(0);
4269 while (true) {
4270 const auto ptr_vec0 = children.pointer_vector[i];
4271 const auto ptr_vec1 = children.pointer_vector[i + 1];
4272 const auto ptr_vec2 = children.pointer_vector[i + 2];
4273 const auto ptr_vec3 = children.pointer_vector[i + 3];
4274 const auto vec0_cmp = vceqq_u64(nullptr_vector, ptr_vec0);
4275 const auto vec1_cmp = vceqq_u64(nullptr_vector, ptr_vec1);
4276 const auto vec2_cmp = vceqq_u64(nullptr_vector, ptr_vec2);
4277 const auto vec3_cmp = vceqq_u64(nullptr_vector, ptr_vec3);
4278 const auto narrowed_cmp0 = vshrn_n_u64(vec0_cmp, 4);
4279 const auto narrowed_cmp1 = vshrn_n_u64(vec1_cmp, 4);
4280 const auto narrowed_cmp2 = vshrn_n_u64(vec2_cmp, 4);
4281 const auto narrowed_cmp3 = vshrn_n_u64(vec3_cmp, 4);
4282 const auto cmp01 = vcombine_u32(narrowed_cmp0, narrowed_cmp1);
4283 const auto cmp23 = vcombine_u32(narrowed_cmp2, narrowed_cmp3);
4284 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
4285 const auto narrowed_cmp01 = vshrn_n_u32(cmp01, 4);
4286 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
4287 const auto narrowed_cmp23 = vshrn_n_u32(cmp23, 4);
4288 const auto cmp = vcombine_u16(narrowed_cmp01, narrowed_cmp23);
4289 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
4290 const auto narrowed_cmp = vshrn_n_u16(cmp, 4);
4291 const auto scalar_pos =
4292 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-const-correctness)
4293 vget_lane_u64(vreinterpret_u64_u8(narrowed_cmp), 0);
4294 if (scalar_pos != 0) {
4295 i = (i << 1U) +
4296 static_cast<unsigned>(std::countr_zero(scalar_pos) >> 3U);
4297 break;
4298 }
4299 i += 4;
4300 }
4301#else // #ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
4302 node_ptr child_ptr;
4303 while (true) {
4304 child_ptr = children.pointer_array[i];
4305 if (child_ptr == nullptr) break;
4306 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(i < 255);
4307 ++i;
4308 }
4309#endif // #ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_X86_64
4310
4311 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSUME(i < parent_class::capacity);
4312
4313#ifndef NDEBUG
4314 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children.pointer_array[i] == nullptr);
4315 for (unsigned j = 0; j < i; ++j)
4316 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children.pointer_array[j] != nullptr);
4317#endif
4318
4319 child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] =
4320 static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
4321 children.pointer_array[i] = node_ptr{child.release(), node_type::LEAF};
4322 this->children_count = children_count_ + 1U;
4323 }
4324
4326 constexpr void add_to_nonfull(node_ptr packed_value,
4327 [[maybe_unused]] tree_depth_type depth,
4328 std::byte key_byte,
4329 std::uint8_t children_count_) noexcept {
4330 // Reuse the leaf overload by wrapping the packed value in a
4331 // temporary unique_ptr that immediately releases. This avoids
4332 // duplicating the SIMD slot-finding logic.
4333 // TODO(#707): refactor to share slot-finding code without this hack.
4334 std::ignore = children_count_;
4335 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] ==
4336 empty_child);
4337 // Find first empty slot (not occupied by pointer or VIS value).
4338 unsigned slot = 0;
4339 while (children.pointer_array[slot] != nullptr ||
4340 is_value_in_slot_by_ci(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(slot))) {
4341 ++slot;
4342 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(slot < parent_class::capacity);
4343 }
4344 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSUME(slot < 48);
4345 child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] =
4346 static_cast<std::uint8_t>(slot);
4347 children.pointer_array[slot] = packed_value;
4348 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte));
4349 this->children_count = this->children_count + 1U;
4350 }
4351
4356 constexpr void remove(
4357 std::uint8_t child_index,
4358 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance) noexcept {
4359 remove_child_pointer(child_index, db_instance);
4360 remove_child_entry(child_index);
4361 }
4362
4366 constexpr void remove_child_entry(std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
4367 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4368 clear_value_bit(child_index);
4369 }
4370 children.pointer_array[child_indexes[child_index]] = node_ptr{nullptr};
4371 child_indexes[child_index] = empty_child;
4372 --this->children_count;
4373 }
4374
4380 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr typename basic_inode_48::find_result
4381 find_child(std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
4382 const auto child_i =
4383 child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)].load();
4384 if (child_i != empty_child) {
4385 return std::make_pair(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte),
4386 &children.pointer_array[child_i]);
4387 }
4388 return parent_class::child_not_found;
4389 }
4390
4411 [[nodiscard, gnu::pure]] constexpr node_ptr get_child(
4412 std::uint8_t child_index) noexcept {
4413 const auto child_i = child_indexes[child_index].load();
4414 // A concurrent modification of child_indexes[] bumps the OLC version tag,
4415 // so the caller's read_critical_section::check() will catch the race, but
4416 // only after we would have indirected past the end of the 48-entry
4417 // children.pointer_array — empty_child is 0xFF, so the load lands far
4418 // outside the node's allocation; return nullptr instead.
4419 return UNODB_DETAIL_UNLIKELY(child_i == empty_child)
4420 ? node_ptr{nullptr}
4421 : children.pointer_array[child_i].load();
4422 }
4423
4430 [[nodiscard]] UNODB_DETAIL_RELEASE_PURE constexpr
4431 typename basic_inode_48::iter_result
4432 begin() noexcept {
4433 for (std::uint64_t i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
4434 sync(sync_in_inode_scan);
4435 if (child_indexes[i] != empty_child) {
4436 const auto key = static_cast<std::byte>(i);
4437 const auto child_index = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);

4859 [[nodiscard]] static auto create_bulk(
4860 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
4861 detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len, unodb::key_view prefix_key,
4862 tree_depth_type depth,
4863 std::span<const detail::bulk_child<node_ptr>> children_span,
4864 const std::array<std::uint8_t, 6>& value_mask = {}) {
4865 const auto n = static_cast<unsigned>(children_span.size());
4866 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(n >= 17 && n <= 48);
4867 auto result =
4868 inode48_type::create(db_instance, n, prefix_len, prefix_key, depth,
4869 typename parent_class::bulk_load_tag{});
4870 auto* node = result.get();
4871 for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
4872 const auto kb = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(children_span[i].key_byte);
4873 node->child_indexes[kb] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
4874 node->children.pointer_array[i] = children_span[i].child;
4875 }
4876 for (unsigned i = n; i < 48; ++i) {
4877 node->children.pointer_array[i] = node_ptr{nullptr};
4878 }
4879 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
4880 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < value_mask.size(); ++i) {
4881 node->bitmask_base::bits[i] = value_mask[i];
4882 }
4883 }
4884 return result;
4885 }

5002 constexpr void init_grow(UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
5003 inode48_type& __restrict source_node,
5004 node_ptr child_val, std::byte key_byte) noexcept {
5005 const auto reclaim_source_node{
5006 ArtPolicy::template make_db_inode_reclaimable_ptr<inode48_type>(
5007 &source_node, db_instance)};
5008 unsigned children_copied = 0;
5009 unsigned i = 0;
5010 while (true) {
5011 const auto children_i = source_node.child_indexes[i].load();
5012 if (children_i == inode48_type::empty_child) {
5013 children[i] = node_ptr{nullptr};
5014 } else {
5015 children[i] = source_node.children.pointer_array[children_i].load();
5016 ++children_copied;
5017 if (children_copied == inode48_type::capacity) break;
5018 }
5019 ++i;
5020 }
5021
5022 ++i;
5023 for (; i < basic_inode_256::capacity; ++i) children[i] = node_ptr{nullptr};
5024
5025 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(
5026 source_node.child_indexes[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)].load() ==
5027 inode48_type::empty_child);
5028 children[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] = child_val;
5029 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
5030 // Copy bitmask from source I48. I48 indexes by slot position,
5031 // I256 indexes by key byte. Map through child_indexes.
5032 for (unsigned j = 0; j < 256; ++j) {
5033 const auto ci = source_node.child_indexes[j].load();
5034 if (ci != inode48_type::empty_child &&
5035 source_node.is_value_in_slot_by_ci(ci)) {
5036 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j));
5037 }
5038 }
5039 set_value_bit(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte));
5040 }
5041 }

5056 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children_count_ < parent_class::capacity);
5057
5058 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(children[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] ==
5059 nullptr);
5060 children[static_cast<std::uint8_t>(key_byte)] =
5061 node_ptr{child.release(), node_type::LEAF};
5062 this->children_count = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(children_count_ + 1U);

5280 // lambda patterns.
5281 template <typename Function>
5282 constexpr void for_each_child(Function func) const
5283 noexcept(noexcept(func(0, node_ptr{nullptr}))) {
5284#ifndef NDEBUG
5285 const auto children_count_ = this->children_count.load();
5286 std::uint8_t actual_children_count = 0;
5287#endif
5288
5289 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
5290 const auto child_ptr = children[i].load();
5291 if (child_ptr != nullptr ||
5292 (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf &&
5293 this->is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i)))) {
5294 func(i, child_ptr);
5295#ifndef NDEBUG
5296 ++actual_children_count;
5297 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(actual_children_count <= children_count_ ||
5298 children_count_ == 0);
5299#endif
5300 }
5301 }
5302 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(actual_children_count == children_count_);
5303 }
5304
5308 constexpr void delete_subtree(
5309 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance) noexcept {
5310 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
5311 for_each_child([this, &db_instance](unsigned i, node_ptr child) noexcept {
5312 if (this->is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i))) return;
5313 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(child, db_instance);
5314 });
5315 } else {
5316 for_each_child(
5317 [&db_instance]([[maybe_unused]] unsigned i, node_ptr child) noexcept {
5318 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(child, db_instance);
5319 });
5320 }
5321 }

5327 [[gnu::cold]] UNODB_DETAIL_NOINLINE void dump(std::ostream& os,
5328 bool recursive) const {
5329 parent_class::dump(os, recursive);
5330 os << ", key bytes & children:\n";
5331 for_each_child([&os, recursive, this](unsigned i, node_ptr child) {
5332 os << ' ';
5333 dump_byte(os, static_cast<std::byte>(i));
5334 os << ' ';
5335 if (recursive) {
5336 if (is_value_in_slot(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i))) {
5337 os << "value=";
5338 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
5339 os << ArtPolicy::unpack_value(child);
5340 }
5341 os << "\n";
5342 } else {
5343 ArtPolicy::dump_node(os, child);
5344 }
5345 }
5346 });
5347 }

5385 UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_CLANG_21_WARNING("-Wnrvo")
5386 [[nodiscard]] static auto create_bulk(
5387 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST db_type& db_instance,
5388 detail::key_prefix_size prefix_len, unodb::key_view prefix_key,
5389 tree_depth_type depth,
5390 std::span<const detail::bulk_child<node_ptr>> children_span,
5391 const std::array<std::uint8_t, 32>& value_mask = {}) {
5392 const auto n = static_cast<unsigned>(children_span.size());
5393 UNODB_DETAIL_ASSERT(n >= 49 && n <= 256);
5394 auto result =
5395 parent_class::create(db_instance, n, prefix_len, prefix_key, depth,
5396 typename parent_class::bulk_load_tag{});
5397 auto* node = result.get();
5398 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
5399 node->children[i] = node_ptr{nullptr};
5400 }
5401 for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
5402 const auto kb = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(children_span[i].key_byte);
5403 node->children[kb] = children_span[i].child;
5404 }
5405 if constexpr (ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf) {
5406 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < value_mask.size(); ++i) {
5407 node->bitmask_base::bits[i] = value_mask[i];
5408 }
5409 }
5410 return result;
5411 }
5412 UNODB_DETAIL_RESTORE_CLANG_21_WARNINGS()

5415// ─── Bulk Load: build_chain ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
5416
5417UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(26815)
5418UNODB_DETAIL_DISABLE_MSVC_WARNING(4459)
5419
5420template <class ArtPolicy>
5421[[nodiscard]] typename ArtPolicy::node_ptr bulk_build_chain(
5422 UNODB_DETAIL_NO_STATS_CONST typename ArtPolicy::db_type& self,
5423 typename ArtPolicy::art_key_type k, typename ArtPolicy::node_ptr child,
5424 tree_depth<typename ArtPolicy::art_key_type> start_depth) {
5425 using node_ptr = typename ArtPolicy::node_ptr;
5426 using inode_4 = typename ArtPolicy::inode4_type;
5427 using tree_depth_type = tree_depth<typename ArtPolicy::art_key_type>;
5428 constexpr std::size_t cap = key_prefix_capacity;
5429 const auto full_key = k.get_key_view();
5430 const auto key_len = k.size();
5431 const auto start = static_cast<std::size_t>(start_depth);
5432 auto current = child;
5433 bool child_is_value = ArtPolicy::can_eliminate_leaf;
5434 bool owns_current = false;
5435 try {
5436 std::size_t pos = key_len;
5437 while (pos > start + cap) {
5438 const auto depth = pos - cap - 1;
5439 const auto dispatch = full_key[pos - 1];
5440 auto remaining = k;
5441 remaining.shift_right(depth);
5442 auto chain{
5443 inode_4::create(self, full_key, remaining,
5444 tree_depth_type{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(depth)},
5445 dispatch, current)};
5446 if (child_is_value) {
5447 chain->set_value_bit(0);
5448 child_is_value = false;
5449 }
5450 current = node_ptr{chain.release(), node_type::I4};
5451 owns_current = true;
5452#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_WITH_STATS
5453 self.template account_growing_inode<node_type::I4>();
5454#endif
5455 pos = depth;
5456 }
5457 if (pos > start) {
5458 const auto dispatch = full_key[pos - 1];
5459 auto chain{inode_4::create(
5460 self, full_key, tree_depth_type{static_cast<std::uint32_t>(start)},
5461 static_cast<key_prefix_size>(pos - start - 1), dispatch, current)};
5462 if (child_is_value) {
5463 chain->set_value_bit(0);
5464 }
5465 current = node_ptr{chain.release(), node_type::I4};
5466#ifdef UNODB_DETAIL_WITH_STATS
5467 self.template account_growing_inode<node_type::I4>();
5468#endif
5469 }
5470 return current;
5471 } catch (...) {
5472 if (owns_current) {
5473 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(current, self);
5474 } else if (!child_is_value) {
5475 ArtPolicy::delete_subtree(current, self);
5476 }
5477 throw;
5478 }
5479}
